chapter.verse: Tua hi a, Pasian' hehpihna thu a hawmpi na suahsak loh nadingun nasemkhawmte ka hihna uh tawh kong hansuah uh hi.

A hang pen Pasian in, “A kilawm hun khat ah note' thugen kong ngai a, hotkhiatna ni khat ah note kong huh khin hi,” ci hi. En un, tu laitak pen a kilawm hun hi; en un, tu laitak pen hotkhiatna ni ahi hi.
Ka seppina uhah mawhsak a om loh nadingin kuamahmah a pukkhak theih nading thu ka bawl kei uh hi.
Tua sangsikin Pasian' nasem ka hihna uh tawh thu khempeuh ah a hoihin kong kipulak uh hi. Tuate pen: nakpi thuakzawhna ahi zongin, gentheihna, dongtuahna, haksatna,
vuakna satna, thongkiatna, thulela kitukkalhna, gimna tawlna, zanmenna, anngawlna, cihte ahi zongin;
siangtho nuntakna, thutheihna, lungduaina, migitna, Kha Siangtho, itna maan, cihte ahi zongin;
thumaan thutak genkhiatna, Pasian' vangliatna, khut taklam leh veilam' ading dikna galhiam, cihte ahi zongin;
pahtawina leh zahpihna, gensiatna leh phatna, cihte ahi zongin, hih thu teng ahi hi. Kote pen zuauphuak hong kisak hangin thumaan a gente;
kuamah' theihloh hong kisak hangin mi tampi' theihte; a si ding hong kisak hangin, en un, a nungta laite; gawtna tuak ding hong kisak hangin thah a thuak lote;
a dah hong kisak hangin a lungdam tawntungte; zawng hong kisak hangin mi tampi a hausakte; bangmah nei lo hong kisak hangin na khempeuh a neite, ka hi uh hi.
Corinth khuamite aw, thu siangtak kong gen khin uh a, itna lungtang zaipi kong hon uh hi.
No na hih uhleh ko bang hilo-in nong lainatna uh tawm mahmah hi.
Tu-in—tate' tunga thugen bangin kong genin ah—i thu a kidit nadingin note in zong itna lungtang zaipi hong hon un.
Thu-umlo mite tawh hakkol kituaklo puakhawm kei un. A hang pen dikna thu in thukhun pampaihna tawh pankhopna bang nei ahi hiam? Khuavak in khuamial tawh kikholhkhopna bangci nam nei ahi hiam?
Khris in Beliar tawh kithukimsa thu bang nei ahi hiam? Thu-um khat in thu-umlo khat tawh bang sehtan nei ahi hiam?

Pasian' biakinnpi in milimte tawh kithukimna bang nei ahi hiam? A hang pen eite a nungta Pasian' biakinnpi i hihlam Pasian in hih bangin gen hi: “Amaute lakah ka teeng ding a, amaute' lakah ka tualbual ding hi. Amaute' Pasian ka hiding a, amaute zong keima' mi hiding uh hi.”
Tua ahih manin Topa in ci hi: “Amaute' lakpan paikhia unla, a tuamin om un. A sianglo nate lawng kei un. Tua hileh note kong sang ding hi.
Tua ciangin note' Pa kong hiding a, note zong keima' tanu tapate na hiding uh hi,” Vanglian Topa in ci hi.
